Backend Engineer - Payments (B2B, 6 months)

Company: PayHive

Contract to build and stabilize our reconciliation service.

- Python services, SQL (Postgres), event-driven design
- Reconciliation of $10M+/month card volumes; idempotency and audit trails
- Kafka + PostgreSQL, Redis for state

Profile: 5+ years backend; production payments or high-volume data experience
Rate: 70-85 USD/hour, 20-30 h/week (B2B invoice)
Remote: EU overlap 08:00-16:00 CEST required
Exclusivity: not required
Application: platform apply or mail payments-eng@payhive.example
notes: Edge case: hourly compensation -> normalizer converts to USD/month; profile fact exp.globex.b1 (payments reconciliation) is the matching proof point.
